description:
Han Boreum just wanted answers about his mysterious illness—not a death sentence. But the shaman he visits drops a bombshell:

*“You’re overflowing with dark yin energy. If you don’t sleep with a man full of yang energy, you won’t live long.”* 

Desperate to survive, Boreum sets out to find his “yang-guy,” and right on cue appears Joo Tae-Yang—campus heartthrob, top business student, and nicknamed “Apollo” by his admirers. Perfect, right? Except... he’s a two-faced jerk only when it comes to Boreum. Still, with his life on the line, Boreum launches a clumsy, tear-filled operation to seduce his moody match. Between awkward attempts at flirtation and unexpected sparks, Boreum starts to wonder— Could survival turn into something a little sweeter?

A one-sided love? A healing romance? Or just a very chaotic medical emergency? Either way, he’s not going down without a fight!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*
